description: Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc. operates in segments including Streaming, which primarily consists of its premium pay-TV and streaming services; Studios, which primarily consists of the production and release of feature films for initial exhibition in theaters, production and initial licensing of television programs to third parties and its networks and streaming services, distribution of its films and television programs to various third party and internal television and streaming services, distribution through the home entertainment market, related consumer products and themed experience licensing, and interactive gaming; and Global Linear Networks, which primarily consists of its television networks. The Company faces industry headwinds such as continued pressures on linear distribution and declines in linear subscribers and continued softness in the U.S. linear advertising market, and the increase of digital advertising inventory available in the marketplace has resulted in increased competition for advertising expenditures for both traditional linear networks and ad-supported tiers in streaming services.
